top_signals.title: TotalEnergies Profit Doubles as War Boosts Refining and Trading
top_signals.summary: TotalEnergies booked $9.1 billion in third-quarter adjusted net income, doubling earnings from a year earlier amid historically high refining margins, higher oil and gas prices, and strong oil and LNG trading.  The French supermajor on Thursday reported an adjusted net income of $9.1 billion, up by 51% from the $6 billion profit for the second quarter, and 127% higher than the $4 billion booked for the third quarter of 2025.  The Q3 2026 income beat the average analyst expectation of $8.3 billion.  Earlier this month, TotalEnergies…

top_signals.title: Shell Profits Nearly Double to $10.8 Billion as Refining Margins Hit Record
top_signals.summary: Record refining margins and higher LNG and gas prices boosted Shell’s third-quarter earnings to over $10.8 billion, nearly double compared to the same period last year, as the Middle East crisis squeezed fuel supplies and hiked oil and gas prices.    Shell on Thursday reported adjusted earnings of $10.814 billion for the third quarter, the highest since 2022, almost double the $5.432 billion earnings a year ago.
